what: PyTorch .pth pickle from the same Hugging Face account; when loaded it downloads the ELF beacon ws_linux_amd64 (SF-D-2026-0004) from the same repository and runs it.

evidence.basis: Rapid7 prints this SHA-256 for wsc.pth in the report's indicators of compromise and describes what the pickle downloads and runs.
